{1000}{Test message line.}
{1010}{My dearest Raven,

Although I must leave on my search for the Dark Elves, I shall keep the moments we shared safely in my heart.  I can only hope that one day we will again walk the trees of Qintarra hand in hand.

Forever I am yours,

Renford A. Terwilliger}
{1020}{I've found a discrepancy in the translations of the Archaeon.  We assumed that "southernmost tip of the land" meant the MAINLAND.  Not true.  This older translation says Nasrudin "crossed the waters" and then laid himself down to rest.
Perhaps his remains are not here, but on the Isle of Thanatos.  The island is southernmost of ANY land in Arcanum.}
{1030}{Stennar's escape from the Void using the unfinished gate pushed our timetable back a fair amount. The dwarves are now being worked twice as hard to facilitate the imminent return of Arronax. Please report on your progress in regards to the Vendigroth matter. We must destroy the device in order to ensure the success of our plan.
                                           K'an Hua}
{1040}{Safe combination:


12-03-70}
{1050}{57 Mulligan Bone Alley}
{1060}{Tuesday Evening...Wellington Gentleman's Club.

Edward Willoughsby........member
James Garringsburg........member
Par Ter'an................member
Rorry Limes...............guest
Basil Pettibone...........member
Ulan Kan'tor..............member
Miles Jeriston............member}

{1070}{I have received the moonshine

--Maximillian}
{1080}{Virgil- 
	I assume you are not alone. As you can see, there are people in Shrouded Hills looking for me. Luckily for me, these fellows were easily dispatched. Do not speak with anyone about the zeppelin crash, or your new companion's involvement with it. When you are able to make your way to Tarant, check the telegram office there. I will leave a message telling you where to contact me.
				Joachim}
{1090}{To whom it may concern:

The bearer of this invitation will have full priveleges within the Wellington Gentlemen's Club, regardless of their gender or race, whether female, orcish or otherwise.

The Mgmt.}
{1100}{A clue to my location
As surely as I live
Find me and Mastery
To you I will give.}
{1101}{Come to the place where old and new reign
Look for an Inn.  Here is a hint to its name
A Room with no windows, no floor and no roof
The number 4 is where you will find proof}
{1110}{Look closely near the beast
with four legs but one foot
Enhance your gift of sight
to make old paintings new and bright.}

{1120}{Here is a note
whose secrets shine bright
when viewed beside The Mushroom's 
bright firelight.}
{1130}{Your race is nearly won
Here's the name that you seek
The Master Prowler 
I am called Albert Leek

A rhyme for the name of a place so near
I am awaiting your visit... come find me here:

Use a knife to slice my head
Weep beside me when I am dead}

//Willenbecker Gang's note to William Thorndop
{1140}{Thorndop.  I have searched far to locate you. COWARD!  
Now is it time to pay for your evil deeds.  You took the life of my brother.  I shall take yours.
Come to the old barn outside of town.  The time of your atonement has come.
If you choose to ignore me, the woman dies.

Jessep Willenbecker}

{1150}{The IFS Zephyr has crashed just outside Shrouded Hills.  Kill "Radcliffe" if he's still alive.  As we don't know who he's spoken to, kill any other survivors.

G.L.
}

{1160}{My dearest Jared, 
		I'm aboard the IFS Zephyr, speeding on my way to see you again. My breath catches when I think that in two short weeks I shall be your wife. That is correct, my dear, I am accepting your proposal! 
	I hope thoughts of me warm your heart on your long days and nights guarding Vermillion Station from the halforc looters you mentioned. 
				Love always, 
					Wilhemina}

{1180}{Loghaire - 
	The judgement on the Black Mountain Clan has been passed. Make certain they are at the appointed meeting place at the agreed upon time. I speak with the authority of the Silver Lady, Queen of the Elves.  If all conditions are not met, we will next meet upon the field of battle.  

				M'in Gorad}

{1190}{
The Crow is in Danger.

		Tyron}

{1200}{Search for the target in the abandoned mines of the Black Mountain Clan.  Any failures, like those in Shrouded Hills, will be met with the most severe punishment.

G.L.
}

{1210}{    From The Desk of 
	 Wendell Wellington



Please allow the bearer of this invitation full access to the club. 

Signed, 
 Wendell Wellington, ESQ.
}

{1220}{Dear Mr. Carrington:

Enclosed is the payment we agreed upon.

Elmer Burbottom}

{1230}{Our mutual benefactor is interested in a place called Haven. See what you can find out about it.

Musin}


{1240}{Here's what I've learned - 
The Panarrii mucky-mucks have an island south of Caladon that they use as a retirement center. There is only two ways to get there that I heard about.
One is a supply ship called The Fair Wind, and the second is by teleport stones. One is in the Caladon temple and the other is south of Tarant in a place called Shrouded Hills.

Hope this helps.
                   Poe}

{1250}{Sruun - 

Mondal wants you to go back to the smelter and make sure the fuel lines have been properly purged.
He was saying something about a possible explosion and we might want to use this place again someday.
Meet you in Caladon at the inn by the new temple. 

I am Jaxom}

{1260}{To my dear Lord Fane,

I regret to inform you I may be a day or two late arriving. 
As you know, I've been busy mounting an expedition to a tomb in the Gray Mountains at 618 x 559, and there's still a few details to attend to. 
Feel free to start without me, but save an animal or two for me!

            See you soon!
         Adam Quartermane }

{1270}{To Muslin,

I've just heard about a cave at 1288 x 677 that's supposed to be full of Star Rubies.
There's some spiders guarding the place, and a curse or two, but nothing we can't handle - Right ?
When you're finished with what you're doing, look me up and we'll go get rich again!

          Nexopuqu
}

{1280}{
      Your information has been more than helpful.
Meet me in Roseborough in order to collect your payment.

Alean San.
 

}

{1290}{
For Sale 
Price Reduced!
Beautiful two bedroom home, fully furnished, with two acres of prime land.
An idea first home for new couples or grandparents. 
See Frigo Furbottom for further details and price.
Terms negotiable - Although serious inquires only, please.
Postscript: I've left the door unlocked for your inspection.
}

{1300}{Locate the island of Haven at any cost and report back to me. The Shrouded Hills temple is rumored to still have a working T.P. stone. Check there first. 
I would recomend posing as Panarii monks in need of free lodging. My sources tell me that there are only two people there at night.

Failure means your life.

               Louie}

{1310}{Just a reminder - make certain that the west entrance is secured before your party heads north. 
The treasure must be kept safe.

Herkal has planted the trees and bushes, but I'd feel better knowing that you had double-checked it.
            
              I am
        Mondal Shale Fist}

{1320}{To: Lord Mayor Richard

To aleviate any concerns, I have taken the liberty of locking a guard into the treasury's antechamber. 
With only the Captain of the Guard and I having a key for each lock, that thief Killroy will never get past our security.

            Yours sincerely,

             N. O. Brayne}

{1330}{





            
      Killroy was here!}

{1340}{To: Major D. E. Zastre

This is to inform you that during the coming week our treasury vault will temporarily host the latest payment to the Iron Clan dwarves.
I trust that you'll redouble the security at the vault in light of the recent boast of that villian Killroy.
           
           Sincerely,
      Lord Mayor Richard}
{1350}{To: Lord Mayor Richard

To put your mind at ease, Treasurer Brayne and I have taken all necessary steps to ensure the safety of the vault and its contents. 
To this end we have rekeyed the locks, and stationed a full-time guard at the door, rotating the men every four hours.

        Major D. E. Zastre}

{1360}{(The dark words look to have been written in blood)

June 24, 1882

To anyone who finds this note - 
Stay away! This place is a death trap!
There is no treasure, no food, no water, only an endless maze and a deadly guardian spirit.
Please tell the world.

    Bowen Tyler}

{1370}{Congratulations thief!
You've done well to make it this far and still be breathing. But, alas, your efforts are for naught.
The treasure you sought is no longer here but has been moved to a place of safety.
However, I believe in rewarding good work, so I will leave you with enough gold to drown your sorrows when you return to Caladon or Terre d' V'nt.

I am Hirae Flamedigger.}

{1200}{28l
 What are Rune stones? Nobody knows.
They have been called Rune stones for centuries now, made by forgotten mages of the past. No one knows their true function, or their true purpose. Many legends surround them, and even more speculation. In one city, a magic shop is built next to one, and the proprietor claims that it gives his products more power. In a rural village, one is said to cure infertility, although they look rather uncomfortable for that activity.
Deep in a dungeon, there was once a cursed book that described their manufacture, placement and  use. They seem to be marriage of magic and technology seemingly impossible today, made of unknown materials and infused with powerful spells.  In order to activate them you need first to touch one of the Binding Stones. The Runestone is the place of your departure. The Binding Stone is the place of your destination. Two known Binding Stones exist. One more Binding stone is rumored to exist. One in a place of true light.
By the  master of literature  Shadygrove and his student Chris
}    

{1210}{28l
There is one Binding Stone in Caladon and one Binding Stone in Tarant. Therefore, from any known Shrine of the Gods you can travel either to Tarant or Caladon. 
Travel requires you to have first touched and activated either the Caladon or Tarant Binding Stone and each person can only have one binding stone activated at a time, that being the last one he has touched. Also in order for the Binding Stone to accept you need to carry a sacrificial item: A ruby for the Tarant Binding Stone and a kathorn crystal for the Caladon Binding Stone. 
When you touch any rune word of power the sacrificial item will disappear and you will be transported instantly to the last Binding Stone that you have touched.
It is also rumored that one Binding Stone exists in the legendary capital of the Elves Qintarra. But it is unknown what is required for its operation .
}

{1220}{28l
It is rumored that one Binding Stone exists in the legendary capital of the Elves Qintarra. But it is unknown what is required for its operation . It is said  that only good and kind persons can use it.
Also lunatics and madmen speaking in riddles speak of a fourth Binding Stone. An evil one.
 They say that it is located in a place exactly the opposite of Qintarra a place where normal teleportation fails. 
They speak of a dark place full of misery and dark mystic energies but anyone who dares to say more about this place suddenly dies from a curious curse.
Such a Binding Stone if it ever existed would be imbued in great evilness and could only be operated by evil persons.
}

mods/Forgotten Places 6.0/Rules/schemati:
// The line begin on multiples on 10. The first line (the multiple of 10)
// is used as the schematic number in the game. So the first and second
// learned anatomical schematics are 1000 and 1010. Each line holds
// the following data:

// 	0. Schematic name. (line number from the name from a message file)
// 	1. Schematic description text. (line number from the text from a message file)
// 	2. Schematic Drawing. (line number for the approprate .art from the interface.mes)
// 	3. Needed Item 1. (prototype number(s) for item 1, can have up to 3 for sized items)
// 	4. Needed Item 2. (prototype number(s) for item 2)
//	5. Result Item. (prototype number(s) for result item)
//	6. Result Amount. (how many result items to make)

example:
[1000][10]	// Schematic name: this is a test
[1001][11]	// Schematic description text
[1002][366]	// Schematic Drawing
